verdict.reasoning: The printed page 29 (folio I-9) opens with the numbered section heading '1.5.2.5.5 The ENTER Statement', set like its siblings. page-29.md holds it as a plain paragraph line, while page-28.md marks 1.5.2.5.1 through 1.5.2.5.4 as '#### ' headings (lines 11, 15, 25, 33) under '### 1.5.2.5 Qualifications'. The text is present and correct; only the heading level is lost, so the claim is a structural defect, not a wording one, as filed. (The 1.6 and 1.7 headings on the same page are also plain lines in the markdown, but those fall outside this claim.)
